p: gods will I sing praise unto: Even in the presence of angels and of them who have authority among men.
temple: Both the temple and ceremonial service at Christ's coming were abolished: so that now God will be worshipped only in spirit and truth, Joh 4:23.
strengthenedst me with strength in my: You have strengthened me against my outward and inward enemies.
kings of the earth shall praise: All the world will confess that you have wonderfully preserved me, and performed your promise.
afar off: Distance of place cannot hinder God to show mercy to his, and so judge the wicked though they think that he is far off.
perfect that which concerneth me: Though my enemies rage, yet the Lord, who has begun his work in me, will continue his grace to the end.
